blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — Bukidnon’s second most wanted person, who is facing a murder case, was arrested before dawn on Saturday in Talakag town, an official said. Capt. Lance Elpedio Figuracion, officer in charge of the Talakag Municipal Police Station, said the 47-year-old driver, a resident of Casisang, Malaybalay City, Bukidnon, was arrested at 12:57 a.m. in Sitio Maligapok, Barangay San Antonio. The suspect also ranks as Malaybalay City’s No. 1 most wanted person.
